decisive_spans.text: On admission, he was febrile (38.5°C), hypotensive (systolic blood pressure 90 mmHg), and tachycardic (heart rate 110/min)

response.rationale: The patient's presentation with fever, hypotension, and tachycardia on admission directly supports Sepsis (D3). While other diagnoses like Lymphoma (D2) are supported by imaging findings, the immediate and life-threatening symptoms of sepsis are clearly described at admission. The other diagnoses are either contradicted or less immediately supported by the initial presentation.
